newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Deutsche to lend 1.5 bln DM for Gazprom pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche to lend 1.5 bln DM for Gazprom pipeline.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG has agreed in principle to extend a 1.5 billion mark credit to Russian gas monopoly Gazprom to finance the purchase of pipeline equipment from Mannesmann AG.

Deutsche Bank management board member Georg Krupp told a Moscow news conference the credit would be in addition to a $2.5 billion credit for the pipeline which is being signed on Friday in Frankfurt. The bank was applying for cover from Germany's Hermes export credit agency.
Krupp said the Gazprom credit would run for up to 10 years. The money -- like that in the dollar loan -- would be used for a pipeline linking Russia's Yamal gasfield with Western Europe.
The dollar loan is being extended by a consortium chaired by Dresdner Bank Ag. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
